The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, August 31, 2018 Posted by admin on August 31st, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), UnitedHealth (UNH) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -70 points.
Thursday the Dow was down -137.65 (-0.53%) at 25,986.92.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.13%.
There were 4 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Apple (AAPL) +0.92% and Walmart (WMT) +0.48%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) -1.97% and Nike (NKE) -1.68%.
If you have owned Visa (V) for the last six months you have done well. Check out it’s chart below.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is unchanged at $2.838 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
